itt_pdf.title: Legal Eligibility and Authorization (PSQ Question 1)
itt_pdf.threshold: Yes (1) for all six cities: Peshawar, Haripur, D.I Khan, Gilgit, Skardu, Quetta
itt_pdf.notes: Scoring: Yes = 1, No = 0. Bidder must confirm legal eligibility, authorization, and compliance with tax registration and regulatory requirements for each city.

itt_pdf.title: OEM Authorization (PSQ Question 2)

itt_pdf.title: Financial Standing Assessment
itt_pdf.threshold: Minimum criteria set out in PSQ table (not detailed in excerpt); British Council may require further information if unacceptable financial risk is presented
itt_pdf.notes: Assessment criteria: turnover relative to contract value, solvency ratios, profitability ratios. Bidders must provide two most recent accounts; audited accounts or financial statements upon request.

source_refs.excerpt: In order to facilitate British Council's assessment of a Participant's economic and financial standing, British Council will assess turnover relative to the Contract Value, solvency ratios and profitability ratios.

itt_pdf.stage: Stage 1: Tender Completion and Compliance Check
itt_pdf.title: Stage 1: Tender Completion and Compliance Check
itt_pdf.notes: Tender responses checked for correct completion and all necessary information provided. All mandatory requirements as set out in specification must be met. Responses not correctly completed or containing omissions are rejected and disqualified automatically.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 1: Tender responses will be checked to ensure that they have been completed correctly and all necessary information has been provided. Tenderers responses correctly completed with all relevant information being provided and all mandatory requirements as set out in the specification met will proceed to Stage 2. Any tender responses not correctly completed in accordance with the requirements of this ITT and/or containing omissions may be rejected at this point.

itt_pdf.stage: Stage 2: Selection Questionnaire and Supplier Qualification Review
itt_pdf.title: Stage 2: Selection Questionnaire and Supplier Qualification Review
itt_pdf.notes: Completed Selection Questionnaire reviewed to confirm potential supplier meets all qualification criteria. Suppliers not meeting qualification criteria are excluded and their tender response rejected in full without further evaluation.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 2: The completed Selection Questionnaire will then be reviewed to confirm that the potential supplier meets all of the qualification criteria set out in the questionnaire. Potential suppliers that meet the qualification criteria will proceed to Stage 3. Potential suppliers that do not meet the qualification criteria set out in the Selection Questionnaire may be excluded from the Procurement Process at this point.

itt_pdf.title: Stage 3: Detailed Tender Response Evaluation
itt_pdf.notes: Bidders passing Stages 1 and 2 have detailed tender response evaluated in accordance with award criteria and scoring methodology. Information from Selection Questionnaire may be verified at this stage.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 3: If a bidder succeeds in passing Stages 1 and 2 of the evaluation, then it will have its detailed tender response to the British Council's requirements evaluated in accordance with the evaluation methodology set out below.

itt_pdf.notes: Responses assessed to determine most advantageous tender using four criteria with stated weightings. Assessment based entirely on response submitted.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Model (Non-Commercial Criteria)
itt_pdf.notes: Tender responses scored by evaluation panel for all criteria other than Commercial using 10-point scale. Responses not meeting mandatory requirements or constraints rejected in full without scoring.

source_refs.excerpt: Scoring Model – Tender responses will be subject to an initial review at the start of Stage 3 of the evaluation process. Any tender responses not meeting mandatory requirements or constraints (if any) will be rejected in full at this point and will not be assessed or scored further. Tender responses not so rejected will be scored by an evaluation panel appointed by the British Council for all criteria other than Commercial using the following scoring model

itt_pdf.title: 10 Points - Excellent
itt_pdf.notes: Overall response demonstrates bidder meets all areas of requirement and provides all evidence requested at level of detail requested. Detailed excellent response meeting all aspects with no ambiguity.

source_refs.excerpt: 10 Excellent – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas evidence requested in the level of detail requested. This, therefore, is a detailed excellent response that meets all aspects of the requirement leaving no ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement.

10 Excellent – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas evidence requested in the level of detail requested. This, therefore, is a detailed excellent response that meets all aspects of the requirement leaving no ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement.

itt_pdf.title: 7 Points - Good
itt_pdf.notes: Overall response demonstrates bidder meets all areas of requirement and provides all evidence requested, but contains some trivial omissions in level of detail. Good response meeting all aspects with only trivial ambiguity.

source_refs.excerpt: 7 Good – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas of evidence requested, but contains some trivial omissions in relation to the level of detail requested in terms of either the response or the evidence. This, therefore, is a good response that meets all aspects of the requirement with only a trivial level ambiguity due the bidders failure to provide all information at the level of detail requested.

7 Good – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement and provides all of the areas of evidence requested, but contains some trivial omissions in relation to the level of detail requested in terms of either the response or the evidence. This, therefore, is a good response that meets all aspects of the requirement with only a trivial level ambiguity due the bidders failure to provide all information at the level of detail requested.

itt_pdf.title: 5 Points - Adequate
itt_pdf.notes: Overall response demonstrates bidder meets all areas of requirement, but not all evidence requested provided. Adequate response with some limited ambiguity due to missing evidence.

source_refs.excerpt: 5 Adequate – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement, but not all of the areas of evidence requested have been provided. This, therefore, is an adequate response, but with some limited ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement due to the bidder's failure to provide all of the evidence requested.

5 Adequate – Overall the response demonstrates that the bidder meets all areas of the requirement, but not all of the areas of evidence requested have been provided. This, therefore, is an adequate response, but with some limited ambiguity as to whether the bidder can meet the requirement due to the bidder's failure to provide all of the evidence requested.

itt_pdf.title: Scoring Scale - Response Quality Assessment
itt_pdf.notes: Scoring scale for qualitative assessment of bidder responses: 10 = Excellent (response demonstrates bidder meets all requirement areas with clear evidence); 7 = Good (response demonstrates bidder meets requirement with minor gaps); 5 = Acceptable (response demonstrates bidder meets requirement but with some ambiguity); 3 = Poor (response does not demonstrate bidder meets requirement in one or more areas with significant ambiguity); 0 = Unacceptable (response is non-compliant or no response provided)

source_refs.excerpt: 10 Excellent – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement in all areas. This is an excellent response with clear evidence that the bidder can meet the requirement. 7 Good – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement with only minor gaps. 5 Acceptable – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement but with some ambiguity as to whether the bidder can fully meet the requirement. 3 Poor – The response does not demonstrate that the bidder meets the requirement in one or more areas. 0 Unacceptable – The response is non-compliant with the requirements of the ITT and/or no response has been provided.

itt_pdf.title: Commercial Evaluation
itt_pdf.notes: Overall Price evaluated by evaluation panel. Maximum offer score of 10 awarded to tender response offering lowest Overall Price. Other responses scored using formula: (Lowest Overall Price / Overall Price being evaluated) x 10 (rounded to two decimal places) = commercial score.

source_refs.excerpt: Commercial Evaluation – Your "Overall Price" (as calculated in accordance with requirements of Annex 4 (Pricing Approach) for the goods and/or services will be evaluated by the evaluation panel for the purposes of the commercial evaluation. A maximum offer score of 10 will be awarded to the tender response offering the lowest "Overall Price". Other tender responses will be awarded a mark by application of the following formula: (Lowest Overall Price/Overall Price being evaluated) x 10 (rounded to two decimal places) = commercial score.

itt_pdf.title: Moderation and Application of Weightings
itt_pdf.notes: Evaluation panel meets to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores obtained by applying relevant weighting factors set out in award criteria table. Percentage scores for each award criteria amalgamated to give percentage score out of 100.

source_refs.excerpt: The evaluation panel appointed for this procurement will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores in terms of a percentage of the overall tender score will be obtained by applying the relevant weighting factors set out as part of the award criteria table above. The percentage scores for each award criteria will be amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

itt_pdf.title: Winning Tender Determination
itt_pdf.notes: Winning tender response is the response scoring highest percentage score out of 100 when applying evaluation methodology, also supported by required verification evidence. British Council decision on verification evidence is final. Failure to provide verification evidence in accordance with specified timescales or evidence not demonstrating compliance may result in full rejection and disqualification.

source_refs.excerpt: The winning tender response shall be the tender response scoring the highest percentage score out of 100 when applying the above evaluation methodology, which is also supported by any required verification evidence (to include, without limitation, any updated information or references relating to any Exclusion Grounds or Conditions of Participation responses) obtained by the Authority relating to any self-certification or other requirements referred to in the Procurement Specific Questionnaire.

This includes self-declarations as to whether any exclusion grounds apply to you or connected persons and, if so, details about the event or conviction and what steps have been taken to prevent such circumstances from occurring again.

annex_2_docx.title: Associated Persons Verification
annex_2_docx.threshold: Associated persons must be registered on CDP and share required information
annex_2_docx.notes: For consortium members or key sub-contractors relied upon to meet conditions of participation (associated persons), supplier must ensure they register, submit and share their information via CDP including exclusion grounds information.

source_refs.excerpt: You will need to also share additional exclusions information for any suppliers that you are relying on to meet the procurement's conditions of participation. These could either be consortium members or key sub-contractors (but excludes any guarantors). This should be done by ensuring that associated persons register, submit and share their information via the CDP (like the prime/main supplier).

annex_2_docx.title: Sub-contractor Debarment Check
annex_2_docx.threshold: All sub-contractors must not be on debarment list
annex_2_docx.notes: All intended sub-contractors (exhaustive list) will be checked against the debarment list. Unknown sub-contractors must be identified and details provided by final tenders.

source_refs.excerpt: In addition to the sub-contractors who are being relied on to meet the conditions of participation (who are associated persons), you will need to share an exhaustive list of all your intended sub-contractors, which will be checked against the debarment list.

evaluation_breakdown.title: 10 Points - Excellent

evaluation_breakdown.title: 5 Points - Adequate

display_rows.title: Scoring Scale - Response Quality Assessment
display_rows.notes: Scoring scale for qualitative assessment of bidder responses: 10 = Excellent (response demonstrates bidder meets all requirement areas with clear evidence); 7 = Good (response demonstrates bidder meets requirement with minor gaps); 5 = Acceptable (response demonstrates bidder meets requirement but with some ambiguity); 3 = Poor (response does not demonstrate bidder meets requirement in one or more areas with significant ambiguity); 0 = Unacceptable (response is non-compliant or no response provided)

source_refs.excerpt: 10 Excellent – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement in all areas. This is an excellent response with clear evidence that the bidder can meet the requirement. 7 Good – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement with only minor gaps. 5 Acceptable – The response demonstrates that the bidder meets the requirement but with some ambiguity as to whether the bidder can fully meet the requirement. 3 Poor – The response does not demonstrate that the bidder meets the requirement in one or more areas. 0 Unacceptable – The response is non-compliant with the requirements of the ITT and/or no response has been provided.

display_rows.title: Commercial Evaluation
display_rows.notes: Overall Price evaluated by evaluation panel. Maximum offer score of 10 awarded to tender response offering lowest Overall Price. Other responses scored using formula: (Lowest Overall Price / Overall Price being evaluated) x 10 (rounded to two decimal places) = commercial score.

source_refs.excerpt: Commercial Evaluation – Your "Overall Price" (as calculated in accordance with requirements of Annex 4 (Pricing Approach) for the goods and/or services will be evaluated by the evaluation panel for the purposes of the commercial evaluation. A maximum offer score of 10 will be awarded to the tender response offering the lowest "Overall Price". Other tender responses will be awarded a mark by application of the following formula: (Lowest Overall Price/Overall Price being evaluated) x 10 (rounded to two decimal places) = commercial score.

display_rows.title: Moderation and Application of Weightings
display_rows.notes: Evaluation panel meets to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores obtained by applying relevant weighting factors set out in award criteria table. Percentage scores for each award criteria amalgamated to give percentage score out of 100.

source_refs.excerpt: The evaluation panel appointed for this procurement will meet to agree and moderate scores for each award criteria. Final scores in terms of a percentage of the overall tender score will be obtained by applying the relevant weighting factors set out as part of the award criteria table above. The percentage scores for each award criteria will be amalgamated to give a percentage score out of 100.

display_rows.title: Winning Tender Determination
display_rows.notes: Winning tender response is the response scoring highest percentage score out of 100 when applying evaluation methodology, also supported by required verification evidence. British Council decision on verification evidence is final. Failure to provide verification evidence in accordance with specified timescales or evidence not demonstrating compliance may result in full rejection and disqualification.

source_refs.excerpt: The winning tender response shall be the tender response scoring the highest percentage score out of 100 when applying the above evaluation methodology, which is also supported by any required verification evidence (to include, without limitation, any updated information or references relating to any Exclusion Grounds or Conditions of Participation responses) obtained by the Authority relating to any self-certification or other requirements referred to in the Procurement Specific Questionnaire.
